name: Finishing in another editor
description: Use when someone wants to finish an edit in Premiere, Final Cut or DaVinci Resolve: export a handoff package, say plainly what each format can't carry, and how to relink media.
verification: Pass or fail comes only from the Editing Studio's checks on the rendered file (QUALITY_GATES); the skill adds no tool, approval or setting.

evals.ask: I want to finish it in DaVinci Resolve
